payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate elements left-to-right; for each, find a shifted index (by erasing earlier elements) where it is not divisible by (index+1). If all elements have such a feasible index, output YES.
payload.rationale: The solution greedily verifies that each element can be erased at some index after earlier removals, implicitly using an exchange argument that erasing earlier only reduces indices, so a feasible later erasure implies sequence can be emptied.
